messages:
Theo: Noticed a burst of tiny-pod evictions in ap-southeast1c ~20m. Cost spike and noisy alerts. Anyone digging? :grimacing:
ops-bot: ALERT: evictions[gpu-ap-southeast1c] = 6.1/min (10m avg).
Priya: We started enforcing gpu.family labels this morning. Old tiny images still require rtx7 via nodeAffinity, so scheduler won't place them on rtxA nodes despite free GPUs -> tight packing on rtx7 -> evictions when medium jobs start.
Nadia: Scheduler log: "Fit failed: node(s) had no matching labels for nodeAffinity gpu.family in [rtx7]".
Carl: Short-term: (1) bump warm-pool in that AZ, (2) flip a few rtxA nodes taint to PreferNoSchedule, (3) roll mutating webhook to rewrite required->preferred for pods with requests.nvidia.com/gpu <= 1.
Theo: I'm scaling warmpool 5->12 now.
ops-bot: RUNBOOK: warmpool scale by Theo at 2025-05-02T07:12:01Z (run rp-5012).
Priya: Deploying webhook canary to ml namespace at 10% first.
Carl: Also raising binpack imbalance_tolerance to 0.18 for ap-southeast1c to allow mixed-family packing until we finish migrating rtx7 workloads. Monitor thermal/NVLink metrics.
Nadia: Early metrics: evictions 6.1 -> 1.3 within 9m after hotfixes. Opening TICKET-5012 "ap-southeast1c tiny-pod eviction wave - affinity/taint fragmentation" assigned infra/runtime.
Theo: Follow-up: inventory scripts to list required gpu.family affinities cluster-wide and CI gate to block new required gpu.family on pod specs.
